turkey_payout_kyc: Withdrawal methods (official): USDT on TRC20, or Rise (crypto or bank transfer); 5% processing fee on crypto rewards deducted from trader share; name must match registered name; KYC documents article exists (not read). Turkey-specific behaviour not stated [uncertain].
platform: Official: cTrader, TradeLocker, Match-Trader and MetaTrader 5 (select before purchase); MT5/cTrader not for US residents. Per-program availability for Instant not stated [uncertain].
ea_clause_text: Official (intercom.help/fundedtradermarkets/en/articles/9999546): "we permit the use of Trading Bots across all accounts and phases, though certain types of bots are restricted." Prohibited: high-frequency trading bots, news scalping bots, bots exploiting demo servers, multi-account reverse trading bots, arbitrage bots (reverse and latency), tick scalping bots, emulators. HFT, tick scalping and copying trades from others/mirroring across accounts prohibited. Copy Trading Rules collection exists (not read). Article does not use the term EA explicitly [uncertain].
overnight_weekend: Official: "Yes, you have the flexibility to hold trades overnight and through the weekend in all our available programs." Crypto: "On all platforms offered, Cryptocurrencies are enabled and available for trading over the weekend."
swap_free_scope: Official (article 17726531): all accounts on all offered programs are swap free by default with no extra charge. Article does not mention crypto explicitly [uncertain], but the official Instruments Specification page lists swap 0% for all crypto symbols including BTCUSD.
us100_btc: Official Instruments Specification (fundedtradermarkets.com/instruments-specification): US100 'US Tech 100 Index CFD' (swap 0%, commission $0) and BTCUSD 'Bitcoin vs US Dollar' (swap 0%, commission $0) listed. Leverage (official): Instant Plus/Standard/Pro 5K-100K: Forex 1:100, commodities 1:20, BTC and ETH 1:2, other crypto 1:5; indices leverage not stated [uncertain]. No fixed lot cap: per-instrument max in platform specs.
drawdown: Official: Instant Standard daily 3% / overall 5% trailing; Instant Pro daily 3% / overall 3% trailing; Instant Plus daily 3% of initial balance (reset 5pm EST from higher of balance/equity) / overall 6% from highest balance, becomes fixed on initial size at +6% profit. Instant Plus Shield Risk Protocol: 1% floating loss closes all positions and cuts profit split stepwise (50/50, 40/60, 30/70, then 20/80).
consistency_min_days: Official: Instant Plus best day not more than 15% of total profit; Standard/Pro/Plus table shows 15%. Minimum 5 qualifying trading days (day counts at 0.5% profit) for Standard, Pro and Plus. Minimum profit for reward 1% of initial balance.
first_payout: Official: withdrawals on-demand for all FTM accounts once consistency rule, minimum reward (1% of initial balance) and minimum trading days (5) are met; no fixed reward dates. Profit split up to 80% (Instant Plus starts at 80/20). 24-hour reward guarantee exists (article 10502664, not read) [uncertain].
news_gambling: Official: news trading is allowed in all programs (caution advised). Prohibited: HFT, tick scalping, copy trading; martingale/layering, margin rule, gap trading, sequential trading have separate articles (not read) [uncertain]. One-sided/gambling rules not addressed in the practices article.
